Episode Notes:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair with a businesswoman whom U.S. intelligence officials reportedly believe is a Chinese spy. Her Singapore-based company bought Nvidia’s advanced chips and is now under scrutiny over whether restricted chips reached China. The case strikes at the center of the AI race: Nvidia’s chips are among the most strategically valuable technologies in the world, and Huang has been one of the most prominent advocates for allowing their sale to China. Kerry talks with Matt Brazil about where the case fits in the long practice of Chinese espionage, why it matters, and what companies and high-profile figures should learn from it. Developments are moving quickly, and since the recording, Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's CEO.
